description: This Kotlin source file defines the `LockOverlayService` class, which implements an Android foreground service responsible for displaying a full-screen overlay requiring a PIN to unlock apps. It manages notification channels, creates and manages overlay views using `ComposeView`, and interacts with a repository to validate PIN codes.

classes.name: LockOverlayService
classes.description: A foreground service that displays a full-screen overlay requiring PIN entry to unlock other apps.

methods.name: onBind
methods.description: Returns null, indicating this service does not bind to any components.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the overlay service by creating notification channel, starting foreground notification, setting up window parameters and overlay view.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Removes the overlay view, stops the foreground service, and performs cleanup.

methods.name: removeOverlay
methods.description: Removes the overlay view from window and stops the foreground service.

methods.name: createChannel
methods.description: Creates a notification channel named 'lock_overlay' for Android Oreo and above.

methods.name: buildNotification
methods.description: Builds and returns a persistent notification for the overlay service.
